item.text: The layout is taking shape, with a large wedding photograph beside a simple RSVP form. I also checked the date: June 14, 2027 falls on a Monday, so I’m keeping June 14 and leaving the weekday off the page.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import base64
p=Path('index.html')
p.write_text(p.read_text().replace('__WEDDING_IMAGE__', 'data:image/jpeg;base64,'+base64.b64encode(Path('/tmp/rsvp-tables.jpg').read_bytes()).decode()))
print('Created index.html:', p.stat().st_size, 'bytes')
PY"
